question: Ashoka appointed ______ to solve the social problems in his region.
solution:
The correct answer is __**dhamma mahamatta**__. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• From 268 to 232 BCE, Ashoka appointed the **Dhamma Mahamatta. Around 260 B.C**.,
 
• He declared Buddhism the official religion.
 
• Also, he established a group of officials known as the dhamma-mahamattas, whose roles included both dhamma propagation and keeping the emperor abreast of public opinion.
 
• Religious practises that include the **sacrifice of animals **are practised.
 
• He hired a new group of officials called **Dhammamahamattas** to carry out his policies.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Samaharta: **In ancient India, the samaharta was responsible for the collection of taxes and revenue from the people in a specific region.
 
• **Nyayadheesh: **Nyayadheesh refers to a judge or magistrate who presides over legal matters and ensures justice is served. 
 
• **Amatya:** Amatya refers to a minister or high-ranking official in ancient Indian administration.
